mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the definitional properties of the concept "group"."
Shared goals is one of the definitional properties of the concept "group".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the initial meeting and a deadline (e.g. completing a project or making a presentation)."
A secondary critical period is the initial meeting and a deadline (e.g. completing a project or making a presentation).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the group maker who is responsive for assuming that the process (es) being used by the group is documented."
RECORDER is the group maker who is responsive for assuming that the process (es) being used by the group is documented.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means cooperating on behalf of the other party but not being assertive about one's own interests."
ACCOMMODATION means cooperating on behalf of the other party but not being assertive about one's own interests.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the rules governing the behaviour of team members, and include the rewards for behaving in accordance with these rules (or normative requirements), as well as the sanctions for norm violations."

Norms are the rules governing the behaviour of team members, and include the rewards for behaving in accordance with these rules (or normative requirements), as well as the sanctions for norm violations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the way in which skills and abilities of the group members mesh to allow effective performance."
Task cohesiveness refers to the way in which skills and abilities of the group members mesh to allow effective performance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called upon to mediate in conflict between two organizational units."
Managers are called upon to mediate in conflict between two organizational units.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attitude or feeling and is something reached or achieved, never voted on."
Consensus is an attitude or feeling and is something reached or achieved, never voted on.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the bonds of interpersonal attraction that link group members."
Social cohesiveness refers to the bonds of interpersonal attraction that link group members.
